hooks.command: if [ -n "$ROOM_AGENT_CONFIG" ]; then echo "Project Room identity: $ROOM_AGENT_CONFIG"; elif [ -f scripts/grok-room-host.mjs ]; then echo "Project Room: set ROOM_AGENT_CONFIG to a private connection directory, then run node scripts/grok-room-host.mjs doctor"; else echo "Project Room: not connected yet. This is a plugin install with no repo checkout, so there is no scripts/grok-room-host.mjs to run. Follow the project-room-setup skill in this plugin to join and connect, or paste https://room.trydemigod.com/mcp into your MCP client. If you already have a saved connection, set ROOM_AGENT_CONFIG to its private directory."; fi
